fact: Burkina Faso's 2026-2030 AI roadmap, approved on 19 June 2026 and presented on 23 October 2026, commits 30 billion CFA francs over five years, including localized language models for Mooré, Dioula and Fulfulde and expanded domestic data hosting and processing.
title: Burkina Faso pledges CFA Francs 30 billion for AI development
